_read_me: By-hand judgements read by build_prepared.py, each with its evidence (research 2026-10-30). QA ids in README.md.

rest_0240.evidence: QA-361: MICHELIN Switzerland 2025 lists 'Arosa (GR) - La Brezza' among the two-star restaurants (_source/michelin_article_ch_all_starred_2025_de.txt) and its live page gives Two Stars, dateAwarded 2025; the launch row's 3 matches no MICHELIN edition

rest_0243.evidence: QA-362: 'Bad Ragaz (SG) - IGNIV by Andreas Caminada' is two-star in MICHELIN Switzerland 2025 (_source/michelin_article_ch_all_starred_2025_de.txt); its MICHELIN page /en/sankt-gallen-region/bad-ragaz/restaurant/igniv-by-andreas-caminada returns 404 and it is not in the live listing (2026-10-30). Kept at the 2025 value: a loss would need the 2026 edition (2 Nov 2026), and 404 alone does not prove closure

rest_0245.evidence: QA-362: 'Basel (BS) - Stucki - Tanja Grandits' is two-star in MICHELIN Switzerland 2025; its MICHELIN page /en/basel-stadt/basel/restaurant/stucki-tanja-grandits returns 404 and it is not in the live listing (2026-10-30). Kept at the 2025 value until the 2026 edition

rest_0251.evidence: QA-362: 'Lenzburg (AG) - Skin's - the restaurant' is two-star in MICHELIN Switzerland 2025; its MICHELIN page /en/aargau-region/lenzburg/restaurant/skin-s-the-restaurant returns 404 and it is not in the live listing (2026-10-30). Kept at the 2025 value until the 2026 edition

rest_0142.match_evidence: QA-364: stored phone +46 414 204 00 is exactly the number on MICHELIN's VYN page; MICHELIN's pin and address (Höga vägen 72, 272 92 Simrishamn) are 2,359 m from the stored Fiskaregatan 2, Skillinge point, so the restaurant moved; stored address and point left for review

rest_0482.evidence: QA-363: Aloë (2 stars in production, launch row labelled 2026) is not in MICHELIN's 2026 Nordic list (_source/michelin_article_nordic_full_list_2026.txt) and its MICHELIN page /en/stockholm-region/stockholm/restaurant/aloe returns 404. Its 2025 value could not be verified (no 2025 full list found on MICHELIN's site; the Internet Archive refused the lookup, HTTP 429), so the relabel the QA-217 rule needs is not proven. Left untouched for a decision; README gives the block
